from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Start date
start_date = datetime(2025, 9, 17)

# Holidays that are not business days
holidays = {
    datetime(2025, 9, 29).date(),
    datetime(2025, 10, 16).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 7).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 14).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 18).date(),
    datetime(2025, 12, 10).date(),
    datetime(2025, 12, 26).date(),
    datetime(2026, 1, 21).date(),
    datetime(2026, 2, 18).date(),
    datetime(2026, 2, 25).date(),
    datetime(2026, 4, 3).date(),
}

def is_business_day(date, holidays):
    """Check if a date is a business day."""
    return date.weekday() < 5 and date not in holidays

# Generate a list of business days starting from start_date
business_days = []
current_date = start_date.date()

# Build list of business days until we have 59
while len(business_days) < 59:
    if is_business_day(current_date, holidays):
        business_days.append(current_date)
    current_date += timedelta(days=1)

# Get the 59th business day (index 58)
result = business_days[58]
print(f"ANSWER: {result}")
